title: fix(plugin-detail): related list row Delete confirm names the row by its declared nameField
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU5y97XtBcJ8qSLSR3B3Djd)_

Fixes #34788

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:相关列表（如「商机 → 相关 → 商机产品明细」）的行删除确认框，现在用子对象声明的 `nameField` 显示记录名，不再显示「Record #ID」。
- **为什么改**:列表配置了列且列里没有名称字段时，取数只取列字段，删除确认框拿不到名称，用户确认删除时看不到删的是哪条。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低，只是取数多带一个名称字段；无权读取或被屏蔽的名称字段仍不取。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 的 `selectFields`（新增的 declared name field 一段）；`RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333.test.tsx`，预期 6 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

`RelatedList`'s `$select` projection (`selectFields`) now also asks for the child object's DECLARED name field (`declaredNameField`: `nameField`, then its deprecated `displayNameField` alias), so the row Delete confirm (`detail.deleteRowConfirmation`, resolved by `getRecordDisplayName`) can name a row whose name column is not shown.

The name field goes through the same gates as the projection's other non-column members (predicate operands, gallery cover): the child object declares it or it is a platform column; the viewer may read it (FLS) when it is declared; the block does not redact it. It is fetched only and never drawn as a column. A derived title field and a `titleFormat` template are not requested: neither is a declared pointer. This is the same arm `ObjectGrid` (`objectGridRowLoad.ts`) and `ListView` already carry for their bulk confirms. A list with no authored columns still sends no projection.

## Why

A related list with authored columns projected its fetch to those columns, `id`, the `$expand` roots, predicate operands and the gallery cover. The confirm reads the name from the row that fetch returned. When the declared `nameField` was not a column, the row arrived without it and the sentence fell to the resolver's `Record #ID` floor.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the delete confirm's existing harness, `RelatedList.deleteConfirmNamed-13333.test.tsx`. Its data source honours `$select` the way the data API does: only the requested keys come back.

- `a nameField no column shows is requested, never drawn, and names the row`: every `$select` contains `full_name`, the fetched row carries it, the drawn columns stay `['email']`, and the dialog says `Are you sure you want to delete "Ada Lovelace"?`.
- `a nameField the principal cannot read is not requested, and the confirm reads the id floor`: FLS denies `full_name`, no `$select` contains it, and the dialog reads `Record #c1` as before.
- `CONTROL: a shown name column is requested once, as before`: columns `['full_name','email']` give the projection `{email, full_name, id}` with no duplicate entry.

Ablation of the fix on commit `33e54b63d3` (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `projection.add(declaredName);` replaced by a no-op marker, auto-restored): the main pin went red (`Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`). The FLS and CONTROL cases stay green under the ablation, as expected, because they assert absence and an unchanged projection. The restore was verified as blob equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live repro, before and after** (CRM example, `objectstack dev` on a private port, Console Vite dev server from this branch's `ui/` source). I made a temporary local edit, `relatedListColumns: ['email']` on `crm_contact.account` (`crm_contact` declares `nameField: 'full_name'`), and restored it afterwards. Steps: Acme Corp account, Contacts tab, row menu, Delete.
  - Before: the request was `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contact?top=25&skip=0&select=id,email&filter=["account","=","f0XomXLBbu835454"]`. Each response row had the keys `id,email`. The dialog said `Are you sure you want to delete "Record #nbkWdK1xsYpQsMvN"?`.
  - After: the request was `...&select=id,email,full_name&...`. Each response row had the keys `id,email,full_name`. The dialog said `Are you sure you want to delete "Ada Lovelace"?`. The table still draws only the Email column.
- The compact related-card face already projects the name (`compactSelect`), so the record page's side panels were unaffected. Only the full table face (the tab, as in the reported path) lost the name.
- Not measured: an object with NO declared `nameField`, whose derived title field (`deriveTitleField`) is not a column, still reads `Record #ID` in this confirm. This matches the `ObjectGrid`/`ListView` arms, which also request only the declared pointer, and an existing pin requires `$select` to be exactly `['id']` for such an object. Left as is.
